Autonomous parking scenarios

Ridgeback explores around a Unitree G1, chooses a parking pose beside it so G1 can reach the basket, drives there under LiDAR supervision and returns to its start. Each card below is one recorded simulator run of the mission in a different scene, labelled with the campaign and the exact code that ran. For a scenario, the newest code comes first; older runs stay as historical evidence and are marked so.

Ground truth (reach, bearing, pose error, clearance) is read from Gazebo for validation only; the mission never sees it. "Sides tried" are the mission's own labels from its estimated G1 heading. A safe failure is a run that parked nowhere unsafe and returned to its start. Evidence folders are under artifacts/, which is not in git; they exist on the machine that recorded them.

Parking priority

  1. G1's left or right side, equally (within 45 deg of G1's own side directions).
  2. Behind G1 (within 30 deg of its back).
  3. In front of G1 (within 30 deg of its heading).
  4. The best remaining safe pose.
  5. Return to the start when no safe pose exists.

The order only ranks poses that already passed every footprint, keep-out, route and height check; a preferred side never overrides safety. A failed attempt is retried up to three times in total, away from the failed direction or side.

The physical robot and its model

The simulated robot carries the measured-mount camera mast and a provisional top-open basket on the rear deck (outside 0.40 x 0.38 m, rim 0.36 m above the deck), copied from the thesis bin because the crate has not been measured. The basket centre is the parking task point, 0.28 m behind the base centre; the planned reach from G1's body axis to it is 0.30-0.60 m. Whether G1's hands can reach into the crate is not modelled. See the geometry reference.

In the P7 campaign the detector ran at the generic 0.55 floor: side-on views of G1 and views beside tall objects scored 0.42-0.55, so heading_90 and no_feasible stopped before planning. The validation-gaps campaign runs the parking detector at 0.40, keeps search confirmation and the first localization at the mission's G1 floor of 0.50, and accepts 0.40-0.50 views during relocalization only near the known G1 position. Earlier layouts of A, E and F and every intermediate run are in the scenario record and the detection-gaps record. One or two runs per scenario show behaviour, not a success rate. The five-run reliability baseline of the standard scene is in the retry record.

Limitations

  • The basket, the mast-top enclosure and G1's hand reach are not measured; access is judged by the reach band only.
  • Height is checked by the camera overlay only within 1.6 m of G1 and only where the camera has looked; Nav2 never sees tabletops.
  • Side poses come close to G1's legs. The LiDAR monitor stops such approaches, and a retry moves elsewhere.
  • OWLv2 scores a static view the same on every frame: when G1 stands side-on in front of a matching background (a steel column) it scores below 0.40 and relocalization times out; this ends safely without parking.
  • During G1-centred exploration the shared explorer drove within 0.02-0.03 m of the pen's objects (ground truth); no parking leg came that close.
  • Ground-truth clearance is sampled at about 1 Hz and treats G1 as a 0.19 m lower-body circle.

Scenario definitions: src/ridgeback_autonomy/config/parking_scenarios.yaml. Reference: parking scenarios.
